title: crash_instinct — plan 2 (3,2 → 5,0 s + transition 5,0 → 5,9 s)
notes: Suite de la même prise que le plan 1 (aucune coupe, PI-020). Analyse : references/crash_instinct/shots/s02.md. Plan écrit APRÈS la construction (oubli signalé à CB le 19/11), contrôlé ensuite. Temps relatifs au début de la vidéo. Temps relatifs au début du plan (image 96 = 0 s). Débit bas : le plan ne couvre que 6 mots, la phrase continue au plan 3.

shots.narration: it. You see, the road runs

camera.move: start of the swoop on the impact
fast swoop down to grass level

actions.what: brakes across the shoulder and slams into the trunk
actions.anim: keyed path + nose dive and rebound; rc.physics.deform crash_dent on the front panels
reactions: the vehicle pitches and bounces back (nose dive then rebound)
consequences: car stays crushed against the trunk

actions.what: the front wheel breaks off, rolls to the planter, wobbles and falls flat
actions.anim: the model's own wheel: follows the car until 106, then keyed roll (spin = distance / radius), wobble, tip over about the path
reactions: falls with gravity, settles flat with a wobble
consequences: object stays where it lands: the wheel lies flat at his feet

actions.what: shocked face on the impact, nervous when the wheel comes
reactions: the face changes ON the word with a 5-frame head pop
the body answers the face (lean back, shoulders up, freeze)

actions.anim: m:sit/A played backwards frame by frame (m:sit/A@=0.95 -> 0.59), card rises 0.30 m, then m:idle/B
consequences: stands annoyed beside the flat wheel

sound.ambience: wind, birds return after the crash
